author: MJPansa
description:
Qwen3.8 Flash-Next native EAGLE feature pool: 37.7M tokens
	

A byte-preserving research dataset of 37696946 physical training tokens across
21082 training conversations, with a separate fixed held-out split. The
original corpus was expanded with local FP4-Local/MTP4 UltraChat continuations.
This is native Flash-width EAGLE-style training data, not a DSpark bridge
dataset, a trained drafter, model weights, or a full-vocabulary-logit cache.
Upload status: Until ARCHIVE_COMPLETE.json… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/MJPansa/qwen38-eagle4-native-features-37m-20261024-5277c167.
